title: Kagamine Len — Let Individuality Shine〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haruka, do you have a minute?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Len?
Yes, how can I help?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Remember how you came to ask us for advice the other day? I was wondering how things went after that.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right. Thank you for helping me with that. What you guys said helped us choose the right offer.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really? That's good to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, it's amazing that you're receiving enough good offers to have to think about which to choose.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is. We've been asked to appear on a segment of a variety show with animals, a quiz program about mysteries and such.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Really? Those sound like fun.
I'm curious as to what these shows are now.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Would you like to see?
I've recorded basically all of the ones we've received offers for.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, then, can you show me?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
Just give me a minute to set everything up.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll start playing it now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <“The Town Revitalization Team!” is such a great title.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This episode focuses on the town's eateries.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Eateries? This is gonna make me hungry, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Everyone's been working so hard, and now it's opening day already. Somehow even I'm excited.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. When you're watching everything happen, it makes you really want to see the town succeed.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
I hope they get lots of customers.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, wow...
That's a huge line!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really is great to see the town coming back to life.

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <The owner comes back with a cat plushie in hand! The snow-white cat, Mya, looks a little confused...>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <Now, Mya's owner leaves the room. You won't believe what happens next...!>

rows.Speaker: Cat
rows.Line: <Meow!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, Mya punched it!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No matter how many times I watch, I'm still amazed every time by this cat's strength. I mean, that plushie flew all the way across the room.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I wouldn't want to be on the receiving end of that. I didn't realize how strong cats were...>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <And the one behind the locked-room mystery of the mountain cottage was...>

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: <C, the cottage's superintendent!>

rows.Speaker: Len & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes!
<Yes!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had a feeling that there was something fishy about their alibi.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. I mean, how can your shoes be dry after walking around in the snow?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. Maybe we should become detectives instead.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, that's everything I've recorded.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Thanks!
That was really fun.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I thought every show was really good...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But the girls had to choose the one that suits them the most.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Which is really amazing. They're looking for the best way to make their dream a reality...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If they pick offers based on that, then I'm sure the shows they work on are going to go great.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You and the others are gonna be on “The Town Revitalization Team!”, right, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I hope things are going well with your shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It won't be airing for a little while, but we're doing our best to make it a good program.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I see.
I'll be looking forward to watching it.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <KAITO, Miku and the others will probably want to see too, so please come show us after it does air.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll make sure to record it so we can all watch.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Thanks!
Hehe. Now I'm even more excited.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Also, sorry for taking up so much of your day off! Again, good luck with that shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Good luck preparing for KAITO's show.
